artifacts.summary: Recommends batch-orchestration-guardrails.md as the canonical home for batch-selection guidance, with a fully drafted section (dominance rule: territory > topic > graph shape) and three pointer-site edits.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent system's context/patterns/ corpus, files split into two registers: 'principle' documents (normative rules, cross-reference mechanisms by path, e.g. batch-orchestration-guardrails.md's own 'states principles only' self-description) and 'mechanism' documents (algorithms/pseudocode for command implementers, e.g. multi-task-operations.md's stated audience 'command developers'). When deciding where new guidance belongs, match its register to an existing file's stated audience/voice before creating a new file — a task's own declared file_scope at creation time (which existing files it lists, and whether it lists a new file at all) is itself a useful signal for this decision.

For multi-criteria selection rules with pairwise conflicts, a useful drafting technique is a strict dominance order (A > B > C) plus an explicit worked table naming the winner and reason for each of the three pairwise conflicts, followed by one worked example applying the rule end-to-end. This makes the guidance mechanically followable rather than a list of considerations a reader must weigh themselves.
